_note: NoöPunk tag-based attributes, skills and statuses (#821). Tomi's draft is the source of truth; this file is the contract both runtimes read. Values that the draft leaves undecided are listed under open_questions and are NOT decided here.
_licensing: NoöPunk-authored. CWN/SWN supply the 3d6 chassis and the 0-4 skill scale, not the text.

meaning.Fitness: How athletic, strong and healthy your body is.
meaning.Cognition: Ability to search, process and understand human language data, human culture and the language-encoded database of the Safenet.
meaning.Awareness: Consciousness, awareness, perception, intuition and wisdom.
meaning.Agency: Free will, coolness, willpower and identity.
meaning.Cyber: Technical aptitude, cyberspace abilities, the cyborg side and the ability to interface with machines.

generation._note: Bands are inclusive lower bounds: 3 -> -2, 4-7 -> -1, 8-13 -> 0, 14-17 -> +1, 18 -> +2. The raw rolled score is never stored on the sheet.

empathy_floor.note: Empathy -3 is outside the human generation range: the character is no longer human and cannot be a player character. The 3d6 generator can never produce it.

storage_range._note: Storage bound only. Human baseline is -2..+2; above +2 is transhuman and the draft sets no ceiling, so 6 is a serialisation guard, not a rule. -3 is the non-human floor the draft names for Empathy.

display._note: A skill tag's number is its rank (0-4), never a penalty: Shoot-1 means skill level 1. A status tag's number is its penalty magnitude unless the tag is positive.

untrained._note: The draft requires two untrained cases: attempted at -1, or impossible. Which skills are impossible untrained is NOT decided in the draft, so the list is empty and the question is recorded below.

Connect.note: Networking and connections; NoöPunk design pending.

Strength.note: Replaces Exert when raw muscular power is required. A skill, not the removed CWN Strength attribute.

Stamina.note: Replaces Exert when endurance is required.

Wetware.note: Renames Heal for biology, medicine, physiology.

Software.note: Renames Program; software and LLMs through a brain interface.

Noöware.note: New: psychology, psychiatry, psychotherapy, psychic integration; the Heal-equivalent for the psyche.

Research.note: Replaces generic Know: find, evaluate, read and understand text and information; the scientific method.

Know.note: Domain-specific Know uses remain under review; generic Know is replaced by Research.

Talk.note: One skill, not two: Talk+Empathy for rapport and compassionate persuasion, Talk+Agency for forceful leadership, conviction, bluffing and authority; another attribute only when the fictional approach justifies it.

Work.note: Which professional Work skills remain useful is Tomi's decision.

checks.untrained: A skill the character has no tag for uses the untrained rule, not rank 0 with no mark.

migration_from_cwn._note: Conceptual mapping from the draft. It is not a single-value copy: several old attributes feed one new tag, so a migration rule must be agreed before existing characters or saves are rewritten.
migration_from_cwn.proposed_default: take the source modifier of the named attribute; where two feed one tag, keep the higher and record the derivation
